objective: Improve complete natural, contentful replies to unseen human utterances, not agreement phrases or token likelihood alone

firstComparison.initialization: same conversation-v2 medium epoch1 terminal3470 model, Adam, Torch RNG, sampler-state checkpoint; verify complete manifest SHA before any future use
firstComparison.treatment: replace a preregistered portion of RP with new admitted human conversation windows; use exactly shared retained RP windows
fixed: ordinary causal CE over genuine body/role/EOS targets
constant inherited terminal LR3e-5 without warmup reset
generation conditions and all legacy gates
firstComparison.whyNotFixedYet: Source admission, actual independent TRAIN volume, complete-turn coverage and resource profiling must establish a non-repeating matched schedule before these can be fixed; placeholder is not an executable preregistration
firstComparison.matching: Match active target counts per batch slot, padding/dropout shapes, retained RP identifiers and step count. Report body, role, EOS, source, speaker, contentful-reply doses separately; do not claim all are equal
firstComparison.checkpointPolicy: same fixed terminal update; selected and terminal never conflated; no tuning to new generated DEV outputs
firstComparison.stopping: fail closed on rights/split/hash/nonfinite or exact restart mismatch; report actual completed steps, no threshold or coefficient changes to rescue outcome

admissionBeforeFreeze: official data-specific license permits acquisition, local processing and ML; redistribution separately resolved
upstream human dialogue process established, generated/synthetic or translated-machine content separated
source-local complete reply topology and persistent speaker IDs resolved or limitations explicitly exclude formal speaker-heldout claims
privacy and deletion provenance operational; no sensitive excerpts committed merely because source public
manual full-thread semantic/content audit passes a numerical rubric frozen before future output evaluation
TRAIN/DEV family, speaker and near-duplicate checks, existing exposed evaluation overlap quarantine
both arms can match meaningful fixed token budget without hidden repeat multiplication
new state-changing run passes small gradient and exact interrupted-resume audit before larger run
disk headroom for atomic checkpoint saving and measured CPU/GPU memory/time

evaluation.existing: unaltered 17/13/9 strict gates, Pareto/repetition limits; original32DEV, content-required24DEV and four self-continuations reported separately
evaluation.newSourceDev: full correct vs unrelated length-controlled vs no-context teacher-forced fixed targets; content-word delta; fixed greedy and previously fixed sampling conditions with full unedited token/text dumps
evaluation.generation: all sentences grammatical and semantically coherent, actual answer content, history-sensitive relevance, no irrelevant persona assertion, repetition and genuine utterance end; expression change alone is not context comprehension
evaluation.generalization: source/topic/speaker/family-heldout where IDs actually support it; no claim from TRAIN memorization
evaluation.human: independent Japanese-native raters and disagreement handling remain required for formal assessment; assistant audit is diagnostic only
evaluation.test: no sealed TEST opened or produced by renaming an inspected reserve
evaluation.successCriterion: pre-fixed contentfulness+full-text semantic improvement over matched control on unseen families without loss of naturalness/repetition/EOS or legacy gates; numerical threshold must be frozen with benchmark before training

ifFailure: If prediction improves without free-generation meaning, prioritize self-history degradation diagnostics. If source-shift does not improve unseen responses, do not mechanically iterate loss coefficients; compare data quality/coverage, budget and capacity in independent experiments. 200 or 2048 steps alone cannot settle capacity.
